build_node_fixer_first_match: build a node fixer that tries multiple fixers in order and returns the first applicable result
create_type_guard_fixer: create a type-guarded node fixer that only applies to nodes of a specific type
build_ancestors_first_graph_fixer: build a graph fixer that applies node fixes to ancestor nodes before descendants with type updates
create_sequential_graph_fixer: create a sequential graph fixer that applies multiple fixers in order and stops on the first error
build_fixpoint_graph_fixer: build a fixpoint graph fixer that repeatedly applies a fixer until no more progress is made
